nodes.label: GNS-MAS project
nodes.rationale: Research on scalable decentralized LLM multi-agent coordination; thesis: scaling is decided at communication/verification, not generation.

nodes.label: ModelRay
nodes.rationale: White-box safety gate for fine-tuned models; replication by third-party auditors is the product.

nodes.label: Latent transfer project (Continuous Learning)
nodes.rationale: Spun off from ModelRay: user wants general reasoning transfer, not safety, as the platform.

nodes.label: JARVIS HPC cluster
nodes.rationale: All LLM inference runs go to JARVIS sbatch jobs; ssh needs user's password so user launches jobs.

nodes.label: Modal (silo-vllm app)
nodes.rationale: Used for basic tests; major jobs on JARVIS. Key never leaves Modal.

nodes.label: AMD developer credit ($100)
nodes.rationale: Extra compute beyond the shared tunnel; spend only on bounded high-value runs and stop idle instances.

nodes.label: Shared vLLM SSH tunnel connection cap (~48)
nodes.rationale: Tunnel failure silently kills other sessions' runs; LLM_MAX_CONNECTIONS=24 per session when two are active.

nodes.label: cloud.sh AMD droplet automation
nodes.rationale: User found manual droplet create/destroy annoying; destroys droplet only after results checksum verifies.

nodes.label: AMD plain ROCm image gotcha

nodes.label: src/utils/llm.py LLM client

nodes.label: generated_eval instances s200-219
nodes.rationale: Already used for evaluation; not truly held out, new seeds (220+) needed.

nodes.label: Strict P (partial correctness) metric
nodes.rationale: III-21 P ignores extra values and maps duplicates to one position, so perfect ceiling < 1.

nodes.label: S metric (share of agents exactly right)
Dup-fixed recall

nodes.label: GNN training plan
nodes.rationale: Personal research, not a formal paper; held-out cases still used for honest self-eval.

nodes.label: GNN v2 design (gate + top-k, edge-biased attention)
nodes.rationale: REINFORCE stalled at 97% zero reward; supervised-on-good-runs converges fast in prior work.

nodes.label: N=5 topology grid results
nodes.rationale: advise wins; random~gossip at N=5; imitation learns habits; bar = advise:random 0.452.

nodes.label: advise:random baseline
nodes.rationale: Bar to beat for any router, not free.

nodes.label: Rule: no centralized hubs
nodes.rationale: SILO-BENCH found emergent leaders drop Level III success 33.3%->0%; aggregator overwhelmed.

nodes.label: Rule: no supervised head start (tabula rasa)
nodes.rationale: Supervised imitation caps router at what the teacher did; oracle/ILP only for eval.

nodes.label: RL reward choices (P+S, coverage shaping, RLOO K=4)
nodes.rationale: User's explicit workshop picks; build exactly these, don't re-litigate.

nodes.label: GNN N=10 campaign / pause
nodes.rationale: RL hurt: credit uncorrelated with useful aiming, gradients ~noise, speak collapse = momentum random walk.

nodes.label: Single-agent oracle eval
nodes.rationale: Showed model can solve tasks; ~0.7 lost in exchange/aggregation.

nodes.label: Evolution hybrid design (LoRA population)
nodes.rationale: Coordination, not delivery, judged bottleneck; later parked as sidetrack.

nodes.label: Sparse mask evolution branch
nodes.rationale: Merges mask-space evolution with evolution design; parked: too complex, hubs, vLLM can't serve per-agent masks.

nodes.label: GNN ES training (CMA-ES replaces RLOO)
nodes.rationale: User believes evolutionary RL suits MAS; sparse-mask design too complex.

nodes.label: MERL dense-signal check
nodes.rationale: No dense per-agent signal predicts P/S; coverage saturated 0.98; MERL not viable.

nodes.label: Phase 0 hybrid at N=10
nodes.rationale: User called evolution/ES detour a sidetrack; masked-why-wait:learned best enforced method in Phase 0d.

nodes.label: Need-based routing reorientation
nodes.rationale: Goal: agents get only what they need; tokens/agent flat vs N; all-to-all spread cannot scale.

nodes.label: A1 need-oracle (one-step need instructions)
nodes.rationale: LLMs execute one-step need instructions reliably, multi-step procedures not.

nodes.label: Verifier L3 eval
nodes.rationale: +0.064 P over 10 L3 tasks (p=0.0006); consensus check needs rounding tolerance.

nodes.label: Capacity view of scaling
nodes.rationale: P tracks per-agent load (r -0.72); later shown confounded with need derivation.

nodes.label: Planner + model router reorientation
nodes.rationale: Coverage saturated; learned edge routers below random advise; every working component is deterministic.

nodes.label: PM/RHC architecture for silo agents
nodes.rationale: Gives constraint control to installer, decentralized, testable; R-hat must be runtime violation rate, not oracle q.

nodes.label: SDK licensing plan (open-core sim + licensed GNN/verifier)
nodes.rationale: Customers run on own GPU clusters; hosted API latency unacceptable.

nodes.label: vNext runtime audit target
nodes.rationale: vNext worktree stale upstream; build base is claude/verifier-gnn-combined.

nodes.label: Context policy result (compiled vs full)
nodes.rationale: No efficiency claim without measured gains; full stays default.

nodes.label: full_proactive context policy
nodes.rationale: Fixes unread-data submissions (S 0->0.73) and fewer calls, not fewer decode tokens.

nodes.label: N=10 confirmatory GNN experiment
nodes.rationale: Learned GNN router regressed quality (pooled paired P -0.213); recommendation: don't adopt.

nodes.label: Runtime exchange branch (push + pull)
nodes.rationale: User wants runtime-managed exchange proven correct/auditable before real inference.

nodes.label: Use-event signal check
nodes.rationale: Answer-level per-edge credit; works on III-21 only (copy tasks); null/negative on held-out.

nodes.label: Architecture audit 2026-10-20
nodes.rationale: Bottleneck = agent integration (53% delivered, 12% integrated) + measurement.

nodes.label: Offline rescore 2026-10-20 (3649 runs)
nodes.rationale: Extras loophole unexploited; dup-fix makes need-oracle flat in N.

nodes.label: phase_pad v2 context-load causal test
nodes.rationale: Load x4.5 cost only -0.020 recall: need structure, not length, drives P.

nodes.label: Need-request pilot (silo-preserving protocol)
nodes.rationale: User brief requires explicit authorization before inference and no commits.

nodes.label: Rule: no local inference
nodes.rationale: A 20h local Ollama run was lost when user shut laptop off.

nodes.label: Causal density check
nodes.rationale: Provenance-level density is null vs P; not a useful regularizer.

nodes.label: Routing done-gate A/B + N sweep
nodes.rationale: Done gate blocks ~5%; comms stay near-quadratic; need to limit who active agents talk to.

nodes.label: topk sweep result
nodes.rationale: topk ties random on P; lowest-id tie-break creates hubs.

nodes.label: Failure decomposition (topk traces)
nodes.rationale: Delivery is the loss at N>=10; provenance 'known' inflated; premature submission.

nodes.label: Coverage gate branch (+cov)
